build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build an EfficientGraphAttentionBlock with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the EfficientGraphAttentionBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features tensors
